lead.headline: Monangai's thumb is fine, which shuts the seat Metcalf needed
lead.deck: You trail 97.6 to 153.6 with only Kamara left. Nothing to set today. Tomorrow's brief is the last before claims process, and the one seat left to weigh is Coker's.
lead.body: The week is lost and it was lost on the other side. Tetairoa McMillan caught 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns on Sunday night, 45.2 points, in the game Jalen Coker sat out with his quad. Kyren Williams added 36.7. Aye-Aye finished on 153.56, and you are on 97.62 with Alvin Kamara to play tonight. Your own bench held 46 points from two backs, Kyle Monangai's 28.0 and Ollie Gordon's 18.0, behind Bhayshul Tuten's 11.1; the projection chose Tuten, no brief overrode it, and even the perfect lineup would have lost by twenty. Monday brought one answer. Monangai had his right thumb imaged and his coach said: 'We think he's going to be OK... more of a day-to-day type deal.' That keeps a 30-carry back on your roster and removes the seat this morning's brief hoped to use for DK Metcalf. It brought no answer on the receivers: Justin Jefferson's coach still has no projection for Week 5 with a bye to follow, Terry McLaurin is listed 'to be determined', and Coker has no return date and can't play before 18 October. Nobody who started for you was hurt. Garrett Wilson's 5.7 came in a game the Jets ran 32 plays, and his coach called him 'one of the engines' on Monday. Tomorrow's brief is the last before waivers process at 01:00 on Wednesday. If Jefferson is ruled out by then, the claim is Metcalf for Coker; if not, there may be no claim at all.
